title: 16-Layer Smoothness-Constrained Quadratic Chirp with Boundary Stabilization
scientific_hypothesis: Enforcing maximum inter-layer thickness delta |Δd|≤25nm with quadratic chirp reparameterization on inner layers reduces impedance mismatch at layer interfaces, improving broadband visible reflectance while maintaining IR transmittance compared to free-variable optimization.
design_principle: Quadratic chirp profile provides smoother refractive index trajectory than linear chirp. Fixing first and last two layers to 75.0nm stabilizes boundary phase reflection. Inner 12 layers follow analytical quadratic thickness distribution with bounded optimization.
proposed_topology: Air | HfO2(75nm) | SiO2(75nm) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(var) | SiO2(var) | HfO2(75nm) | SiO2(75nm) | Fused Silica substrate. Total 16 finite layers.
design_variables: Inner 12 layer thicknesses with quadratic chirp parameterization
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness smoothness constraint aids deposition uniformity
Fixed boundary layers simplify edge termination
theory_basis: Graded index coating principle reduces interface discontinuities
Quadratic chirp provides smoother impedance trajectory than linear
expected_advantages: Reduced scattering at interfaces due to thickness smoothness
Better broadband performance than 12L with fewer optimization variables than 24L
Boundary stabilization prevents edge reflection anomalies
known_risks: Fewer layers may limit visible band rejection bandwidth
Quadratic chirp may not match optimal thickness distribution for dual-band objective
execution_request_english: Design and optimize a 16-layer alternating HfO2/SiO2 dielectric stack on fused silica substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2-HfO2-SiO2. Fix layers 1, 2, 15, 16 to 75.0nm each. Optimize layers 3-14 (12 inner layers) with quadratic chirp thickness parameterization. Enforce maximum inter-layer thickness delta constraint |Δd|≤25nm during optimization. Wavelength bands: maximize transmittance 1530-1565nm, maximize reflectance 400-700nm. Use gradient-based thickness optimizer with smoothness constraint. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 1530-1565 nm, 400-700 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 1530-1565 nm band; High reflectance in 400-700 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: Low reflectance in 1530-1565 nm band; Low transmittance in 400-700 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Maximum 30 layers.
revision_reason: Changed from 24L free optimization to 16L with quadratic chirp and |Δd|≤25nm constraint to address score regression in iterations 06/09/14. Tests whether smoothness constraint improves impedance matching while reducing optimization complexity.
